name: Great Valley
description: In the shadow of the towering Godspire Mountains lies the ancient lands of the giants. This majestic valley, partitioned among the giant kin, has thrived by upholding ancient pacts of peace with the humans to the south and between the giant kinds themselves. The Pact gave rise to the One Council, an assembly where leaders of each giant kind meet to deliberate the affairs of the valley and ensure the sacred vows of their ancestors endured. At each solstice, or when an emergency meeting is required, the One Council is held in the Earth and Sky Temple, a magnificent colossal tower of stone and crystal at the center of the valley protected by powerful magical wards. Yet, the once harmonious coexistence has frayed at the edges, simmering toward conflict. A titan named Abhorroth, consumed by the corruption of the Ungods, has cast a shadow over the region. He has sown discord, swaying the younger and the power-hungry among the giants and casting aspersions to suggest the humans, the Kolbjörners, have forsaken the old Pact. Though the most sensible of the elder giants remain impervious to his machinations, those who have allied with him have formed what is now known as the Giant Empire. This burgeoning coalition, open to all giantkind, seeks to usurp the valley and ignite a war against Kolbjörn. In their eyes, the battle is for the birth of a Giant Empire; for Abhorroth, it is a means to an end—a massacre intended to invoke a Malrokian Curse to empower his master, Droggath.
